code:
rnn = nn.RNN(input_size=10, hidden_size=20,
             num_layers=1, batch_first=True)

x = torch.randn(4, 7, 10)   # (batch, seq_len, input)
h0 = torch.zeros(1, 4, 20)  # (layers, batch, hidden)

output, h_n = rnn(x, h0)
# output: (4, 7, 20) -- every timestep
# h_n:    (1, 4, 20) -- final timestep only
caption: batch_first=True keeps shapes as (batch, seq_len, features).
